title: Taste of the World Cup: Argentina
description:
Date: Saturday, June 27 | Jordan vs. Argentina 7 PM PST
Date: Friday, July 3rd | Argentina vs. TBD 3 PM PST

Catch Argentina's next World Cup match on the big screen at Lala's or at one of the many Kick It viewing locations across Los Angeles!
Find a viewing location near you: https://kickit.lacity.gov/

As Los Angeles welcomes the world for the 48-team World Cup 2026, communities across the city are sharing their culture through food, tradition, and hospitality.

In this episode of Taste of the World Cup: Argentina, we visit Lala's Argentine Grill, a beloved Los Angeles restaurant serving authentic Argentine cuisine and a taste of South American culture.

From sizzling steaks and traditional flavors to stories of heritage and community, discover how Los Angeles is celebrating the world's game—one match, one story, and one meal at a time.
